calls.video_title: 2020 was a great buying opportunity. Next one is NOW...
calls.thesis: Meta's 2021 ~80% correction left operating profits doubling ($46bn to $83-84bn) and the stock doubling by 2025; same setup now, ~30-40% off peak — 'can it double from here? Yes, and it will double'. He is adding this week.
calls.base_case: Hold/buy through volatility; profits keep growing and the stock follows
calls.bull_case: Doubles from here as profits did 2021-2025
calls.bear_case: AI bubble / capex slowdown breaks the earnings growth
calls.note: First tracked individual META BUY (previously only via blanket 'US AI STOCKS' BUY).
